name: Divine Lotus
review:
Divine Lotus is a 6-reel, 4,096-ways Asian slot with mystery symbols and a free spins bonus with symbol transformation.

Its standout is the 87,089x cap, huge for Thunderkick, with Very High volatility and a 96.14% RTP.

Despite the gentle lotus-and-dragon artwork, this is one of the most volatile games in Thunderkick's catalogue, so most of the value sits in the transforming free spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
